It gives my skin the nourishment I want overnight without leaving me feeling greasy or heavy, and most importantly, it didn't cause any breakouts. I also appreciate that Beekman designed this cream to deliver anti-aging benefits without the irritation often associated with traditional retinol products. My skin feels hydrated, comfortable, and smoother by morning, and it layers beautifully with the rest of my routine. The goat milk, ceramides, and skin-supporting ingredients help keep my skin barrier happy, which is a huge plus for sensitive skin. Another thing I love is the refill system. The reusable glass jar and refill pods mean I'm not paying for unnecessary packaging every time I repurchase, which feels like a more sustainable option. For anyone with sensitive, acne-prone skin who wants hydration and anti-aging benefits without feeling oily or irritated, this has become one of my favorite nighttime moisturizers.
